title: Integrality over affine groupoid invariants
statement: Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $R=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose $s,t:R\to U$, $e:U\to R$, $i:R\to R$ and $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ [def-pc-fibre-product] are morphisms such that, functorially in every test scheme $H$, $U(H)$ is the object set and $R(H)$ the arrow set of a groupoid with source $s$, target $t$, identity $e$, inverse $i$ and composition $c$. Write $\sigma=s^\sharp,\tau=t^\sharp:A\to B$ and $C=\{a\in A:\sigma(a)=\tau(a)\}$. Assume $s,t$ are finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. Then $A$ is integral over $C$: every $a\in A$ satisfies a monic polynomial in $C[T]$.
